description: Fork of exp209 (E=192, qk_dim=64, val_bpb=1.7991 @ 8K, 59M). Single change: V2D n_pairs from E*log2(E)=1456 to 3*E*log2(E)=4368. Each per-head V2D now samples 3x more pair differences (23.8% vs 7.95% of E*(E-1)/2 = 18,336 possible pairs). Wq/Wk/Wv input dim grows 3x. Hypothesis: with smaller E, the V2D pair-difference space is the rank bottleneck for Q/K/V; tripling D should give the per-head linear projection more directions to choose from. Adds ~17M params via Wq/Wk/Wv (4.19M -> 12.58M per layer).
